tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('inventory.csv')

# Unattached EBS: state 'available'
ebs = df[(df.resource_kind=='ebs_volume') & (df.state=='available')]
# Unassociated EIPs
eip = df[(df.resource_kind=='elastic_ip') & (df.state=='unassociated')]
# Idle EC2: running AND cpu<2 AND net<5
ec2 = df[(df.resource_kind=='ec2_instance') & (df.state=='running') &
         (df.avg_cpu_pct_14d<2) & (df.max_network_mb_14d<5)]
# LB with zero requests
lb = df[(df.resource_kind=='load_balancer') & (df.requests_14d==0)]

total = ebs.monthly_cost_usd.sum() + eip.monthly_cost_usd.sum() + ec2.monthly_cost_usd.sum() + lb.monthly_cost_usd.sum()
print(len(ebs), ebs.monthly_cost_usd.sum())
print(len(eip), eip.monthly_cost_usd.sum())
print(len(ec2), ec2.monthly_cost_usd.sum())
print(len(lb), lb.monthly_cost_usd.sum())
print(round(total,2))
